Good enough, Requires UI refinements. 
As someone who works with blockchian, it was intuitive enough. For general public it might be confusing to understand what "enabling SUSD" or Approving means. 
Also all the buttons changes states if one of them is active, eg: if we are in process of Approving SUSD, UI shows Locking and Signing.. button active. And this feedback box is very tiny, I cannot edit my text now. :)
very immersive experience. would recommend to everyone. execution was smooth and easy to understand.
It is fine, confusing but is nice. Can do better with the UI
This was an interesting experience for sure man,  a little confusing, the website can also be optimized, also neds more onboarding, as a person who is using web3 for the first time is confused.

the steps for testing were very clearly explained. Although im not sure what i was testing so i was confused with what SUSD and all meant wasnt quite sure what i was doing there. The ui is pretty clean and straightforward. Everything is clear and u dont have any trouble finding anything. Could be made better but i dont mind it for its use. The application otherwise worked pretty smoothly and i didmt have any issues
